package demo;
import javax.baja.sys.*;
public final class BGuardNote extends BComponent {
  private Clock.Ticket ticket;
  public void changed(Property p, Context cx) {
    // TODO: add an isRunning() guard here
    ticket = Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.makeSeconds(5), armed, null);
  }
  public void stopped() { if (ticket != null) ticket.cancel(); }
}
